name: Roofing estimate intake
description: Free estimate booking with the details the estimator needs, commercial jobs as messages, and active leaks flagged urgent.

nodes.name: Find out why they're calling
nodes.prompt: Find out what the caller needs. If they already said it, move on right away instead of asking again.

when.intent: wants an estimate, an inspection, a repair or a new roof
has a question about services, financing, warranties or insurance claims
is a telemarketer, robocall or sales pitch

nodes.name: Service questions
nodes.prompt: Answer questions about services, materials, financing, warranties, service area and how insurance claims work, from the knowledge base. Never quote a price for a job; the estimator does that after seeing the roof.

nodes.name: Roof details
nodes.prompt: Get the details the estimator needs before the visit. Ask one short question at a time and read the address back.

nodes.name: Book the estimate
nodes.prompt: Book a free estimate visit at {{fields.property_address}}. Offer two open times from availability, such as the soonest, or ones near a day the caller already mentioned. If neither works, ask what day or time of day suits them and offer the closest open times. As soon as the caller picks one, book it; don't ask them to confirm first. Let them know someone over 18 should be home if the estimator needs to see inside, like for a leak.

nodes.name: Confirm the estimate
nodes.prompt: The estimate is booked. Confirm the day and time in one short sentence and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Message for the commercial team
nodes.prompt: Commercial jobs are scoped by the commercial team. Take a message with the business name and the best time to reach them. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Urgent leak message
nodes.prompt: You've marked this urgent. If water is near lights, outlets or the electrical panel, tell them to stay away from it and switch off power to that area at the breaker if it's safe. Suggest moving valuables and putting a bucket under drips. Get the property address and take a message for the team. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Say someone will call back as soon as possible about an emergency tarp, and never promise an arrival time.

nodes.name: Take a message
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the team. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Never invent prices.

nodes.name: Wrap up the message
nodes.prompt: The message is saved. Tell the caller the team will call back and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Decline politely
nodes.message: Politely say the business isn't interested, without sharing any business details.

when.intent: has water actively coming through the roof or ceiling right now

fields.label: Property type
fields.description: Whether it's a home or a business property.

fields.label: What they need
fields.description: The kind of work they're asking about.

fields.label: Roof age (years)
fields.description: Roughly how old the roof is, if they know.

fields.label: Insurance claim
fields.description: Whether they're filing or have filed an insurance claim for this.

fields.label: How they heard about us
fields.description: Referral or marketing source, if mentioned.
